---
title: "Bacillus Growth and Headspace Pressure"
output: html_document
---

This model starts at inoculation, after the bottles have equilibrated at the
experimental temperature. It assumes a closed jar, fixed pH, glucose as the
only modeled carbon source, and aerobic growth.

## Setup and parameters




# ------------------------------ Packages ----------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("deSolve", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install deSolve first: install.packages('deSolve')")
}
library(deSolve)

# ------------------------------ Conditions -------------------------------
cfg <- list(
  # Bottle and liquid
  Vgas_L = 0.075,
  Vliquid_L = 0.050,
  pressure_initial_atm = 1.0,

  # Temperature and pH
  temp_C = 37,
  pH = 7.5,

  # Initial headspace: air
  yO2_initial = 0.2095,
  yCO2_initial = 0.0004,

  # Medium and inoculum
  glucose_mM = 20,
  cells0_per_mL = 1e6,
  cell_dry_mass_pg = 0.3,

  # Growth and substrate use
  K_glucose_g_L = 0.05,
  K_O2_mol_L = 1e-5,
  yield_B_glucose = 0.50,
  maintenance_glucose_g_g_h = 0.005,
  lag_time_h = 0.5,

  # Oxygen-transfer scenarios
  kLa_O2_values = c(0.5, 1, 3, 10, 30),

  # Held fixed to isolate the effect of oxygen transfer
  kLa_CO2_per_h = 10,

  # Simulation
  time_end_h = 24,
  time_step_h = 0.05
)

Rgas_L_atm_mol_K <- 0.082057366
Rgas_J_mol_K <- 8.314462618
MW_glucose_g_mol <- 180.156
MW_biomass_g_mol <- 113.117  # approximate C5H7O2N biomass formula

# -------------------------- Temperature functions ------------------------
# Henry coefficients vary with temperature using a van't Hoff approximation.
# H25 is the coefficient at 25 C; deltaH_sol is an approximate dissolution
# enthalpy in J/mol. These are simple temperature corrections, not fitted
# parameters for this particular vessel.
henry_at_temp <- function(H25, deltaH_sol_J_mol, temp_C) {
  temp_K <- temp_C + 273.15
  temp25_K <- 298.15

  H25 * exp(
    -deltaH_sol_J_mol / Rgas_J_mol_K *
      (1 / temp_K - 1 / temp25_K)
  )
}

# Water vapor pressure from the Antoine equation, returned in atm.
water_vapor_pressure_atm <- function(temp_C) {
  A <- 8.07131
  B <- 1730.63
  C <- 233.426

  10^(A - B / (C + temp_C)) / 760
}

# Approximate carbonate pKa adjustments from 25 C.
pKa1_at_temp <- function(temp_C) {
  6.35 - 0.0017 * (temp_C - 25)
}

pKa2_at_temp <- function(temp_C) {
  10.33 - 0.0065 * (temp_C - 25)
}

carbonate_alpha <- function(pH, pKa1, pKa2) {
  1 + 10^(pH - pKa1) + 10^(2 * pH - pKa1 - pKa2)
}

cfg$temp_K <- cfg$temp_C + 273.15
cfg$H_O2 <- henry_at_temp(
  H25 = 0.0013,
  deltaH_sol_J_mol = -12000,
  temp_C = cfg$temp_C
)
cfg$H_CO2 <- henry_at_temp(
  H25 = 0.033,
  deltaH_sol_J_mol = -19000,
  temp_C = cfg$temp_C
)
cfg$water_vapor_atm <- water_vapor_pressure_atm(cfg$temp_C)
cfg$pKa1 <- pKa1_at_temp(cfg$temp_C)
cfg$pKa2 <- pKa2_at_temp(cfg$temp_C)
cfg$alpha_DIC <- carbonate_alpha(cfg$pH, cfg$pKa1, cfg$pKa2)

# -------------------- Initial conditions and stoichiometry ----------------
cfg$glucose0_g_L <- cfg$glucose_mM / 1000 * MW_glucose_g_mol

# Convert cells/mL and cell dry mass to g biomass/L.
cfg$B0_g_L <- cfg$cells0_per_mL * 1000 *
  cfg$cell_dry_mass_pg * 1e-12

# Estimate oxygen and CO2 per gram of biomass from a simple elemental balance:
# glucose + ammonia -> biomass (C5H7O2N) + CO2 + water.
n_biomass_per_glucose <- cfg$yield_B_glucose *
  MW_glucose_g_mol / MW_biomass_g_mol

co2_per_glucose <- 6 - 5 * n_biomass_per_glucose
water_per_glucose <- 6 - 2 * n_biomass_per_glucose
o2_per_glucose <- (
  2 * n_biomass_per_glucose +
    2 * co2_per_glucose +
    water_per_glucose - 6
) / 2

cfg$qO2_growth_mol_g <- o2_per_glucose /
  (cfg$yield_B_glucose * MW_glucose_g_mol)
cfg$qCO2_growth_mol_g <- co2_per_glucose /
  (cfg$yield_B_glucose * MW_glucose_g_mol)

# Initial dry-gas pressure excludes water vapor.
Pdry0_atm <- cfg$pressure_initial_atm - cfg$water_vapor_atm

nO2_0_mol <- cfg$yO2_initial * Pdry0_atm * cfg$Vgas_L /
  (Rgas_L_atm_mol_K * cfg$temp_K)
nCO2_0_mol <- cfg$yCO2_initial * Pdry0_atm * cfg$Vgas_L /
  (Rgas_L_atm_mol_K * cfg$temp_K)
nInert_0_mol <- (1 - cfg$yO2_initial - cfg$yCO2_initial) *
  Pdry0_atm * cfg$Vgas_L /
  (Rgas_L_atm_mol_K * cfg$temp_K)

# Assume the broth starts equilibrated with the air headspace.
O0_mol_L <- cfg$H_O2 * cfg$yO2_initial * Pdry0_atm
DIC0_mol_L <- cfg$alpha_DIC * cfg$H_CO2 *
  cfg$yCO2_initial * Pdry0_atm

# Approximate upper bound on biomass from the initial oxygen inventory.
O2_initial_total_mol <- nO2_0_mol + O0_mol_L * cfg$Vliquid_L
Bmax_from_O2_g_L <- cfg$B0_g_L +
  O2_initial_total_mol /
  (cfg$qO2_growth_mol_g * cfg$Vliquid_L)

cat("Initial biomass:", signif(cfg$B0_g_L, 3), "g/L\n")
cat("Initial glucose:", signif(cfg$glucose0_g_L, 3), "g/L\n")
cat("Approximate biomass ceiling from initial O2:",
    signif(Bmax_from_O2_g_L, 3), "g/L\n")

# -------------------------------- ODE model --------------------------------
run_model <- function(kLa_O2_per_h, doubling_min) {
  mu_max_per_h <- log(2) / (doubling_min / 60)

  initial_state <- c(
    B = cfg$B0_g_L,
    glucose = cfg$glucose0_g_L,
    O = O0_mol_L,
    DIC = DIC0_mol_L,
    nO2 = nO2_0_mol,
    nCO2 = nCO2_0_mol,
    lag = 0,
    O2_cumulative = 0
  )

  model <- function(time, state, parms) {
    with(as.list(state), {
      B_pos <- max(B, 0)
      glucose_pos <- max(glucose, 0)
      O_pos <- max(O, 0)
      DIC_pos <- max(DIC, 0)
      nO2_pos <- max(nO2, 0)
      nCO2_pos <- max(nCO2, 0)
      lag_pos <- min(max(lag, 0), 1)

      pO2 <- nO2_pos * Rgas_L_atm_mol_K * cfg$temp_K / cfg$Vgas_L
      pCO2 <- nCO2_pos * Rgas_L_atm_mol_K * cfg$temp_K / cfg$Vgas_L

      f_glucose <- glucose_pos /
        (cfg$K_glucose_g_L + glucose_pos)
      f_O2 <- O_pos / (cfg$K_O2_mol_L + O_pos)

      mu <- mu_max_per_h * lag_pos * f_glucose * f_O2
      growth_g_L_h <- mu * B_pos

      # Maintenance uses glucose and oxygen, but does not make new biomass.
      maintenance_glucose_g_L_h <-
        cfg$maintenance_glucose_g_g_h * B_pos * f_O2

      glucose_use_g_L_h <- if (glucose_pos > 0) {
        growth_g_L_h / cfg$yield_B_glucose +
          maintenance_glucose_g_L_h
      } else {
        0
      }

      # Maintenance respiration assumes complete glucose oxidation.
      maintenance_resp_mol_L_h <-
        6 / MW_glucose_g_mol * maintenance_glucose_g_L_h

      # Total respiration rates in mol/h for the bottle.
      rO2_mol_h <- cfg$Vliquid_L * (
        cfg$qO2_growth_mol_g * growth_g_L_h +
          maintenance_resp_mol_L_h
      )

      rCO2_mol_h <- cfg$Vliquid_L * (
        cfg$qCO2_growth_mol_g * growth_g_L_h +
          maintenance_resp_mol_L_h
      )

      # Positive flux means gas moves from headspace into liquid.
      J_O2_mol_h <- kLa_O2_per_h * cfg$Vliquid_L *
        (cfg$H_O2 * pO2 - O_pos)

      CO2_star_mol_L <- DIC_pos / cfg$alpha_DIC
      J_CO2_mol_h <- cfg$kLa_CO2_per_h * cfg$Vliquid_L *
        (cfg$H_CO2 * pCO2 - CO2_star_mol_L)

      dB <- growth_g_L_h
      dglucose <- -glucose_use_g_L_h
      dO <- (J_O2_mol_h - rO2_mol_h) / cfg$Vliquid_L
      dDIC <- (J_CO2_mol_h + rCO2_mol_h) / cfg$Vliquid_L
      dnO2 <- -J_O2_mol_h
      dnCO2 <- -J_CO2_mol_h
      dlag <- (1 - lag_pos) / cfg$lag_time_h
      dO2_cumulative <- rO2_mol_h

      list(
        c(dB, dglucose, dO, dDIC, dnO2, dnCO2, dlag, dO2_cumulative),
        mu_per_h = mu,
        O2_uptake_mol_h = rO2_mol_h,
        pO2_headspace_atm = pO2,
        pCO2_headspace_atm = pCO2
      )
    })
  }

  times_h <- seq(0, cfg$time_end_h, by = cfg$time_step_h)

  out <- as.data.frame(deSolve::ode(
    y = initial_state,
    times = times_h,
    func = model,
    parms = NULL,
    method = "lsoda"
  ))

  out$O_mg_L <- out$O * 32.00 * 1000
  out$pO2_atm <- out$nO2 * Rgas_L_atm_mol_K *
    cfg$temp_K / cfg$Vgas_L
  out$pCO2_atm <- out$nCO2 * Rgas_L_atm_mol_K *
    cfg$temp_K / cfg$Vgas_L

  pN2_atm <- nInert_0_mol * Rgas_L_atm_mol_K *
    cfg$temp_K / cfg$Vgas_L

  out$pressure_atm <- out$pO2_atm + out$pCO2_atm +
    pN2_atm + cfg$water_vapor_atm
  out$pressure_change_mbar <-
    (out$pressure_atm - out$pressure_atm[1]) * 1013.25

  out
}

# ---------------------------- Run scenarios -------------------------------
kLa_values <- cfg$kLa_O2_values
doubling_values_min <- c(30, 40)

scenario_outputs <- list()

for (doubling_min in doubling_values_min) {
  for (kLa in kLa_values) {
    key <- paste(doubling_min, kLa, sep = "_")
    scenario_outputs[[key]] <- run_model(
      kLa_O2_per_h = kLa,
      doubling_min = doubling_min
    )
  }
}

scenario_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(scenario_outputs), function(key) {
  out <- scenario_outputs[[key]]
  end <- nrow(out)
  pieces <- strsplit(key, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  data.frame(
    doubling_min = as.numeric(pieces[1]),
    kLa_O2_per_h = as.numeric(pieces[2]),
    biomass_24h_g_L = out$B[end],
    glucose_24h_g_L = out$glucose[end],
    dissolved_O2_24h_mg_L = out$O_mg_L[end],
    headspace_pO2_24h_atm = out$pO2_atm[end],
    pressure_change_24h_mbar = out$pressure_change_mbar[end]
  )
}))

scenario_summary <- scenario_summary[
  order(scenario_summary$doubling_min, scenario_summary$kLa_O2_per_h),
]
round(scenario_summary, 3)

# ---------------------------------- Plots ----------------------------------
# Plot one doubling-time setting at a time.
doubling_min_to_plot <- 40

plot_data <- lapply(kLa_values, function(kLa) {
  key <- paste(doubling_min_to_plot, kLa, sep = "_")
  scenario_outputs[[key]]
})

plot_colors <- c(
  "#8c510a", "#d28e00", "#35978f", "#4c78a8", "#6a3d9a"
)

plot_panel <- function(variable, ylab, title, show_legend = FALSE) {
  y <- do.call(cbind, lapply(plot_data, function(d) d[[variable]]))

  matplot(
    plot_data[[1]]$time, y,
    type = "l",
    lty = 1,
    lwd = 2,
    col = plot_colors,
    xlab = "Time after inoculation (h)",
    ylab = ylab,
    main = title
  )

  if (show_legend) {
    legend(
      "topright",
      legend = paste0("kLa O2 = ", kLa_values, " h-1"),
      col = plot_colors,
      lty = 1,
      lwd = 2,
      cex = 0.8,
      bty = "n"
    )
  }
}

old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

plot_panel("B", "Biomass (g/L)", "Biomass")
plot_panel("glucose", "Glucose (g/L)", "Glucose")
plot_panel("O_mg_L", "Dissolved O2 (mg/L)", "Dissolved oxygen")
plot_panel("pO2_atm", "Headspace pO2 (atm)", "Headspace oxygen")
plot_panel(
  "pressure_change_mbar",
  "Pressure change (mbar)",
  "Pressure change"
)
plot_panel(
  "O2_uptake_mol_h",
  "O2 uptake (mol/h)",
  "Respiration",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

par(old_par)
```
